title: Tenant namespace label mismatch causing operator reconcile stalls during staggered on-prem upgrades
creator: Aisha Gupta
description: Summary: Several enterprise Private customers experienced partial failures during a staggered operator+Helm upgrade window where the operator stopped reconciling tenant resources for a subset of namespaces. Symptoms: tenant workloads remained on old controller revisions, KV cache entries diverged, and healthprobes reported 'resource not found' for operator-managed CRs in affected namespaces. The problem correlated with namespaces that had an asynchronous namespace-label mutation pipeline (external admission controller) which briefly removed or delayed the expected 'redwood-managed=true' label the operator relies on to select tenant namespaces during a staged upgrade. Root cause: operator reconcile loop uses label-based namespace selection for staged/upgraded cohorts to avoid touching non-upgrade groups. When namespace label writes were reordered by a customer's admission controller, the operator saw the namespace as out-of-scope and skipped reconcile for the tenant's CRs. This left tenants half-upgraded and eventually caused KV schema drift between operator and tenant-agent components. Impact: 4 paying customers with Dedicated/private clusters experienced degraded API latency and two escalations to support. Immediate mitigation: run a one-off cluster-scoped label-backfill job (kubectl apply -f internal/ops/label-syncer.yaml) and trigger operator manual reconciliation for affected tenants. Permanent fix: patch operator to tolerate missing labels during the upgrade window (fallback to annotation-based selector and a reconciliation grace window), ship a background migration controller to backfill labels/annotations safely, and harden operator instrumentation and alerts for skipped namespaces.

acceptance_criteria: Operator no longer skips tenant CRs when namespace label is transiently absent during staged upgrades (verified in synthetic staging with delayed label admission controller).
Background migration controller successfully backfills labels/annotations for 100% of namespaces in affected clusters without causing reconcile storms.
E2E test covering label-less namespace reconcile added to CI and green for all target platforms (GKE/EKS/AKS and on-prem).
A/B canary rollout completed (canary-1..3) with no customer-impacting regressions and automated rollback tested.
New alert 'operator.namespace_selection_skips' fires when operator skips >5 namespaces in 10m and runs a self-heal suggestion, and dashboards updated (console-2026.03).
Post-deploy customer confirmation: affected customers acknowledge recovery and no data loss observed.
